Definition: from G4012 and G2038; to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle):--be a busybody.
BiblicalUsage: Periergazomai means to be a busybody, to bustle about other men's work. Paul heard that some in Thessalonica walked disorderly, working not at all but being busybodies.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a busybody is an idle worker in reverse: he works at everything except his own calling.
